request: Analyze GSE159217 for PMID 34219410 (Matrisome, innervation and oxidative metabolism affected in older compared with younger males with similar physical activity.): how exercise affects gene expression as the paper intends.

final.primary_estimand: Cross-sectional age effect: older (65-71 y, n=18) vs young (19-27 y, n=20) male vastus lateralis, groups deliberately MATCHED for physical activity (ABS.p2, S1.p3, S2.2.p1). No exercise intervention, no acute bout, no active-vs-sedentary arm.
planned_contrasts: Older vs Young, DESeq2 (S2.5.p2; paper: 4327 DEGs, 3797 coding: 1891 up / 1906 down in older; S3.1.p1) - age contrast, not exercise

Within-group association of expression with continuous MVPA time, limma-voom (S2.5.p2, S3.4.p4; paper: 662 genes older, 1058 young at unadjusted P<0.05) - the only physical-activity analysis; needs per-subject MVPA
final.paper_method: DESeq2 ~ age group after removing genes with <10 reads per row; limma-voom (TMM) with MVPA as continuous covariate within each age group
final.sample_inclusion: 38 males with high-quality RNA; two older subjects excluded before deposition (S2.2.p1)

paper_reconstruction.reasoning: Paper design is an age comparison under matched physical activity (S1.p3, S2.2.p1, S4.p1). Its only physical-activity analysis is a correlation with accelerometry-measured MVPA within each age group (S3.4.p4, FIG5F, Figure S3A) at raw P<0.05.

checks: all male vastus lateralis, BGISEQ-500, STAR+HTSeq matches S2.5.p1

ownership.reasoning: Data availability statement and sample counts match.

alignment.reasoning: Merged-tar columns are GSM<id>_<title>_counts; extract GSM id and match metadata index exactly. age alias from 'age group' characteristic.

final.source: GSE159217_RAW.tar per-sample HTSeq count files merged

matrix.reasoning: integer_fraction 1.0, max ~2.06M, Ensembl IDs; data_processing: STAR + HTSeq; matches paper input.

design.stop_reason: No exercise contrast identifiable. The only grouping factor is age (Young/Older), and the paper matched the groups on physical activity (S2.2.p1, S1.p3), so Older vs Young estimates ageing, not exercise. The paper's physical-activity analysis (expression vs continuous MVPA, S3.4.p4) needs per-subject accelerometry MVPA, which GSE159217 metadata does not contain (only title, sex, tissue, age group); it is not in the paper's supplement either. An exercise effect therefore cannot be estimated from the deposited data.

candidates.reason_rejected: Executable, but it is an ageing estimand with activity held equal by design; running it would not answer how exercise affects gene expression.

candidates.value: expression ~ MVPA within each age group (limma-voom)
candidates.reason_rejected: MVPA per subject not deposited in GEO metadata or the paper; covariate unavailable.

design.reasoning: Request asks for the exercise effect as the paper intends; the paper intends no exercise contrast and its activity association cannot be reconstructed.

discrepancies.paper: per-subject accelerometry MVPA used in limma-voom association (S2.5.p2, S3.4.p4)
